title: A customer question about Troubleshooting Sync Issues

question.author: member_272
question.body: I need a short answer about troubleshooting sync issues. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: The most common causes are corporate proxies, antivirus scanning of the sync folder, and file locks from other applications. If the client is stuck on "Syncing…" for more than a few minutes: pause and resume sync; check your proxy or firewall settings (CloudBox uses port 443); clear the local cache under Settings > Advanced; then restart the client. If the problem persists, collect the logs from the client's logs folder and open a support ticket. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
